title: Inference Functionals and Observation Operators for Distributional Statistical Models
summary: This paper generalises inference functions (Godambe, 1960) to distributional statistical models, in which each probability measure is represented by a distribution--kernel pair $(T_θ, \varphi) \in \mathcal S'(\mathbb R) \times \mathcal S(\mathbb R)$. The generalisation is strategically motivated: the key properties of maximum likelihood estimation-consistency and asymptotic normality -derive not from maximising the likelihood but from the MLE being the root of a regular inference function.
